You can export body-weight measurements to a UTF-8 CSV file and restore from the same format. The file header is date,weight_kg. Dates are ISO (yyyy-MM-dd), and the decimal mark in the file is a period.

Your data stays on this device. There is no account, no cloud, and nothing is sent anywhere. There are no ads and no analytics.
The whole file is checked first. If any row is invalid, nothing is saved. If a date already exists in the app, the file value overwrites it. Duplicate dates inside the file are errors.
